definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is relatively old. A polite and neutral way to refer to older people, more respectful than alternatives.

examples.japanese: {年配|ねんぱい}の{方|かた}に{席|せき}を{譲|ゆず}る。
examples.english: To give up one's seat to an elderly person.

examples.japanese: {年配|ねんぱい}の{男性|だんせい}が{話|はな}しかけてきた。
examples.english: An elderly man spoke to me.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{年配|ねんぱい}の{客|きゃく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This shop has many older customers.

notes:
{年配|ねんぱい} is a polite, respectful way to refer to older people.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {年配|ねんぱい}の{方|かた}: older person (polite)
- {年配|ねんぱい}の{男性|だんせい}/{女性|じょせい}: older man/woman

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年配|ねんぱい}: elderly, older (polite, neutral)
- お{年寄|としよ}り: elderly person (common, respectful)
- {高齢者|こうれいしゃ}: senior citizen (formal, used in official contexts)
